text:
tereza: POC with DataWave in 30m. All /v1/generate calls return 403: {"error":{"message":"permission denied: org mismatch","code":403}}. They copied key from console. Need quick checklist. :rotating_light:

mohit: that text = org binding. Ask for sanitized headers + key id/account. Also check SDK env vars.

tereza: customer pasted this sanitized curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_dw_demo_9f" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hi"}'
```
No Redwood-Org header. Dashboard shows key bound to org `datawave-staging`. Their app env is `REDWOOD_ORG=datawave-prod`.

presales-bot: Note: header vs env mismatch common. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#key-bindings :information_source:

mohit: fastest unblock: ask them to set header `Redwood-Org: datawave-staging` for demo. If they can't change config, we can do a temporary server-side alias mapping for account. Need ops approval + audit.

ops: we can add an alias mapping (datawave-prod -> datawave-staging) for acct_99002 for up to 45 minutes. Approve?

tereza: acct id `acct_99002`, key id `key_dw_9f`. Customer says security won't rotate keys during demo. We'll need the alias. Justification: live sales demo, no rotation allowed.

ops: approved 45m alias and RPS bump to 25 for demo window. Creating audit record now.

audit-bot: Audit record: "TEMP-ORG-ALIAS acct_99002 key_dw_9f map datawave-prod->datawave-staging expire=45m approver=ops reason=live demo"

mohit: after alias goes live, ask customer to retry with this quick test: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_dw_demo_9f" 
 -H "Redwood-Org: datawave-prod" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"status"}'
```
If 200 -> resolved. If still 403 collect `x-rw-request-id` and last 4 chars of key id and DM infra.

tereza: sending to customer now. Will report back. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
